name: Startups List

sources.title: Startups List — live network of ~75 city-specific startup directories (city.startups-list.com subdomains + partner domains); per-city lists of startups

requirements: City-scoped — you list under your city's subdomain (e.g., sanfrancisco.startups-list.com)
Each city site historically had an 'add your startup' flow; main page is a city selector
Free listing model historically — verify on the city subdomain
preparation: A startup HQ'd in (or associated with) one of the ~75 covered cities
workflow: Pick your city subdomain from startups-list.com
Use the city's add/claim flow to list the startup
Listing appears on the city page
watchFor: City coverage is finite — if your city isn't listed, no fit
Some city links go to separate partner domains (nycstartups.net, builtinmtl.com) with their own rules
countsAsLive: The startup appears on its city's startups-list page
